# BankMasker — Full API Reference for LLMs

> Lightweight Java 17+ library for masking sensitive data during Jackson JSON serialization — and beyond.
> Repository: https://github.com/zeytx/bankmasker
> License: MIT

This document contains the complete API reference and source code for all public classes.
Use this to generate code that integrates BankMasker correctly.

---

## Compatibility

`@MaskData` works with both Jackson 2 (`com.fasterxml.jackson`, Spring Boot 3) and Jackson 3
(`tools.jackson`, Spring Boot 4) with no module or configuration. The annotation carries both
`@com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize(using = MaskingSerializer.class)` and
`@tools.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize(using = Jackson3MaskingSerializer.class)`;
each Jackson version reads its own and the JVM ignores the one whose classes are absent.
Both Jackson versions are `provided` dependencies: bring the one(s) you use.

With `-Xlint:all -Werror` and a single Jackson version, javac warns about the other version's
missing annotation (`[classfile]`); add `-Xlint:-classfile`.

## Installation

Maven (core only):
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.zeytx</groupId>
    <artifactId>bankmasker-core</artifactId>
    <version>1.3.1</version>
</dependency>
```

Maven (Spring Boot — includes core):
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.zeytx</groupId>
    <artifactId>bankmasker-spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
    <version>1.3.1</version>
</dependency>
```

Gradle (core only):
```groovy
implementation 'io.github.zeytx:bankmasker-core:1.3.1'
```

Gradle (Spring Boot):
```groovy
implementation 'io.github.zeytx:bankmasker-spring-boot-starter:1.3.1'
```

---

## Complete Source: MaskData.java (annotation)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JacksonAnnotationsInside;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
import java.lang.annotation.*;

@Documented
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.FIELD, ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT})
@JacksonAnnotationsInside
@JsonSerialize(using = MaskingSerializer.class)
public @interface MaskData {
    MaskType value() default MaskType.TOTAL;
    char maskChar() default '*';
    int visibleStart() default 0;
    int visibleEnd() default 0;
    MaskType[] keyMask() default {};   // since 1.1.0: mask Map keys with this (single) type
}
```

Supported field types: String and other scalars (Number, UUID, char[], java.time
dates, enums), Optional of those (empty → null), and collections/maps/arrays of
them (masked element by element, JSON shape preserved; map keys visible unless
`keyMask` is set — colliding masked keys get a `~2`, `~3`, … suffix). Any
other object (POJO) is fully masked as `********` — never via its toString().

## Complete Source: MaskType.java (16 built-in types)

Available enum values and their behavior:

| MaskType | Example Input | Example Output | Rule |
|----------|--------------|----------------|------|
| CREDIT_CARD | 4111111111111111 | ****-****-****-1111 | strips non-digits, keeps last 4 |
| EMAIL | john@example.com | jo****@example.com | keeps first 2 chars + domain (local part of 3: first char; 1-2: none) |
| PHONE | +525512345678 | ********5678 | strips non-digits, keeps last 4 |
| DNI | ABCD123456 | ******3456 | keeps last 4 chars |
| IBAN | ES6621000418401234567891 | ES******************7891 | keeps country code (2) + last 4 |
| SSN | 123-45-6789 | ***-**-6789 | strips non-digits, keeps last 4, formatted |
| NAME | John Doe | J*** D** | keeps first letter of each word |
| PASSPORT | AB1234567 | AB****567 | keeps first 2 + last 3 |
| BANK_ACCOUNT | 12345678901234 | **********1234 | strips non-digits, keeps last 4 |
| IP_ADDRESS | 192.168.1.100 / 2001:db8::8a2e:7334 | ***.***.***.100 / ****:****::****:7334 | keeps last octet / IPv6 group |
| AUTO | (card/email/IBAN/SSN/national ID/phone) | (matching mask) | detects format via MaskPatterns; total mask if unknown |
| TOTAL | anything | ******** | replaces entire value |
| CUSTOM | (configurable) | (configurable) | uses maskChar, visibleStart, visibleEnd |
| CREDIT_CARD_BIN | 4111111111111111 | 411111******1111 | BIN (6) + last 4, PCI DSS display maximum; < 13 digits → **** |
| BIRTH_DATE | 1990-05-12 | 1990-**-** | keeps the first 4-digit run (year); no year → total |
| PSEUDONYM | CUS-123456 | 5f1c0a7be2d94c38 | HMAC-SHA256 under MaskingConfig.setPseudonymKey, 16 hex; no key → total |

All built-in types respect `MaskingConfig.getDefaultMaskChar()`.

Fail-closed: types that keep the last characters (CREDIT_CARD, PHONE, DNI, IBAN,
SSN, BANK_ACCOUNT) fully mask values whose visible part would be as large as
the hidden one, e.g. CREDIT_CARD on "12345" → "****", IBAN shorter than 12 → "****".

## Complete Source: MaskUtils.java (programmatic masking)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

public final class MaskUtils {
    // Mask with a built-in type
    public static String mask(String value, MaskType type);

    // Mask with custom parameters
    public static String mask(String value, char maskChar, int visibleStart, int visibleEnd);

    // Mask with an explicit config (since 1.3.0)
    public static String mask(String value, MaskType type, MaskingConfig config);

    // toString() with @MaskData fields masked, e.g. "Payment[card=****-****-****-1111, amount=10.00]"
    // (since 1.3.0; records' generated toString() and Lombok @ToString print them in clear text)
    public static String toMaskedString(Object object);
}
```

Usage:
```java
MaskUtils.mask("4111111111111111", MaskType.CREDIT_CARD);  // "****-****-****-1111"
MaskUtils.mask("john@mail.com", MaskType.EMAIL);            // "jo****@mail.com"
MaskUtils.mask("ABCDEFGHIJK", '#', 2, 3);                   // "AB######IJK"
```

Returns null for null input, empty string for empty input.
Returns original value when `MaskingConfig.getInstance().isEnabled()` is false.

## Complete Source: MaskingConfig.java (configuration)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

public final class MaskingConfig {
    // Global singleton
    public static MaskingConfig getInstance();

    // Create independent instance for per-ObjectMapper use
    public static MaskingConfig create();

    public boolean isEnabled();                              // default: true
    public MaskingConfig setEnabled(boolean enabled);

    public char getDefaultMaskChar();                        // default: '*'
    public MaskingConfig setDefaultMaskChar(char c);       // rejects control chars, surrogates, '"' and '\\'

    // since 1.3.0
    public MaskingConfig setPseudonymKey(byte[] key);       // >= 16 bytes, for MaskType.PSEUDONYM
    public MaskingConfig maskField(String property, MaskType type); // mask by JSON property name
    public MaskType getFieldMask(String property);
    public Map<String, MaskType> getFieldMasks();
    public MaskingConfig clearFieldMasks();

    public MaskingAuditLogger getAuditLogger();              // default: null
    public MaskingConfig setAuditLogger(MaskingAuditLogger logger);

    public MaskingConfig reset();                            // resets to defaults
}
```

## Complete Source: MaskingModule.java (per-ObjectMapper config)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.Module;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public class MaskingModule extends Module {
    public MaskingModule(MaskingConfig config);  // throws IllegalArgumentException if null
    public MaskingConfig getConfig();
}
```

Usage:
```java
MaskingConfig tenantConfig = MaskingConfig.create()
    .setEnabled(true)
    .setDefaultMaskChar('#');

ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
mapper.registerModule(new MaskingModule(tenantConfig));
// This mapper uses '#', other mappers keep using global config '*'
```

## Complete Source: Jackson3MaskingModule.java (per-mapper config, Jackson 3)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

import tools.jackson.databind.JacksonModule;

public class Jackson3MaskingModule extends JacksonModule {   // since 1.2.0
    public Jackson3MaskingModule(MaskingConfig config);    // throws IllegalArgumentException if null
    public MaskingConfig getConfig();
}
```

Usage (Jackson 3 mappers are immutable — register on the builder):
```java
JsonMapper mapper = JsonMapper.builder()
    .addModule(new Jackson3MaskingModule(MaskingConfig.create().setDefaultMaskChar('#')))
    .build();
```

## Complete Source: MaskingStrategy.java (custom strategy interface)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

@FunctionalInterface
public interface MaskingStrategy {
    String mask(String value);
}
```

## Complete Source: MaskingAuditLogger.java

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

@FunctionalInterface
public interface MaskingAuditLogger {
    void onFieldMasked(String fieldName, MaskType maskType);
}
```

## Complete Source: Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger.java

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

import org.slf4j.event.Level;

public class Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger implements MaskingAuditLogger {
    public Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger();             // logs at INFO
    public Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger(Level level);  // logs at the given level
    public Level getLevel();
    // Logs: [BankMasker] Masked field '{fieldName}' using {maskType}
    public void onFieldMasked(String fieldName, MaskType maskType);
}
```

## Complete Source: MaskPatterns.java (format detection)

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker;

public final class MaskPatterns {
    // 13-19 digits (optional single space/dash separators) passing Luhn
    public static boolean isCreditCard(String value);
    public static boolean isEmail(String value);
    // country code + 2 check digits + 11-30 alphanumerics, spaces allowed
    public static boolean isIban(String value);
    public static boolean passesLuhn(String digits);
    // since 1.3.0
    public static boolean isSsn(String value);        // dashed, assignable ranges
    public static boolean isPhone(String value);      // "+..." or separated local format, 8-15 digits
    public static boolean isNationalId(String value); // ES DNI/NIE, BR CPF, CL RUT, AR CUIT/CUIL, MX CURP
}
```

Used by `MaskType.AUTO` and the `bankmasker-logging` module.

## bankmasker-logging module (free-text log masking)

Maven:
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.zeytx</groupId>
    <artifactId>bankmasker-logging</artifactId>
    <version>1.3.1</version>
</dependency>
```

Masks secrets and personal data found anywhere in a log message. Respects the
global MaskingConfig unless an explicit one is set.

```java
package io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging;

public final class LogMasker {
    public static String maskMessage(String message);   // default detectors
    public static LogMasker defaults();
    public static Builder builder();                     // since 1.3.0
    public static LogMasker fromOptions(Collection<String> options); // "+PHONE", "-EMAIL"
    public String mask(String message);
    public Set<Detector> getDetectors();

    public enum Detector {
        PRIVATE_KEY, TRACK_DATA, URL_CREDENTIALS, JWT, AUTH_HEADER, API_KEY, KEY_VALUE,
        IBAN, PAN, SSN, NATIONAL_ID, EMAIL,
        PHONE, IP_ADDRESS   // off by default
    }

    public static final class Builder {
        public Builder enable(Detector... d);
        public Builder disable(Detector... d);
        public Builder sensitiveKeys(String... names);  // extra KEY_VALUE keys, matched as suffixes
        public Builder config(MaskingConfig config);
        public LogMasker build();
    }
}
```

Secrets keep a non-secret hint: "ghp_********", "sk_live_********",
"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.********" (JWT header), "Authorization: Bearer ********",
"jdbc:postgresql://admin:********@db/app", "{\"password\":\"********\"}".

Logback (logback.xml):
```xml
<conversionRule conversionWord="maskedMsg"
                converterClass="io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.logback.MaskingMessageConverter"/>
<conversionRule conversionWord="maskedEx"
                converterClass="io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.logback.MaskingThrowableProxyConverter"/>
<!-- use %maskedMsg instead of %msg and %maskedEx instead of %ex -->
<pattern>%d %-5level %logger - %maskedMsg%n%maskedEx</pattern>
```

Log4j2: use `%maskedMsg` (or `%mm`) and `%maskedEx` (or `%mex`) in the
PatternLayout — the converters
(`io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.log4j2.MaskingMessagePatternConverter`,
`io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.log4j2.MaskingThrowablePatternConverter`)
are auto-discovered via their @Plugin annotation.

Always include `%maskedEx` (options as for `%ex`, e.g. `%maskedEx{short}`):
if the pattern has no throwable converter, Logback and Log4j2 append the
stack trace unmasked, and exception messages often contain sensitive data.

Detector toggles as converter options: `%maskedMsg{+PHONE, -EMAIL}` (Logback),
`%maskedMsg{+PHONE,-EMAIL}` (Log4j2), `%maskedEx{short, +PHONE}`.

JSON logs (where `%maskedMsg` does not apply):
```yaml
# Spring Boot 3.4+ structured logging: masks every string value
logging:
  structured:
    json:
      customizer: io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.spring.MaskingJsonMembersCustomizer
```
```xml
<!-- logstash-logback-encoder 9+ -->
<encoder class="net.logstash.logback.encoder.LogstashEncoder">
  <decorator class="net.logstash.logback.mask.MaskingJsonGeneratorDecorator">
    <valueMasker class="io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.logging.logback.MaskingValueMasker"/>
  </decorator>
</encoder>

<!-- Log4j2 JSON layouts: message and MDC rewritten before the layout -->
<Rewrite name="Masked">
  <MaskingRewritePolicy detectors="+PHONE"/>
  <AppenderRef ref="Json"/>
</Rewrite>
```

## Spring Boot Auto-Configuration

application.yml:
```yaml
bankmasker:
  enabled: true              # default: true
  default-mask-char: '*'     # default: *
  pseudonym-key: ...         # since 1.3.0, >= 16 chars, for PSEUDONYM
  fields:                    # since 1.3.0, mask properties by name
    password: TOTAL
  audit:
    enabled: false           # default: false — set true for SLF4J audit logging
    level: INFO              # default: INFO — TRACE/DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR
```

Auto-configures `MaskingConfig` bean and optionally registers `Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger`.
Registers `MaskingModule` (Jackson 2) / `Jackson3MaskingModule` (Jackson 3) beans that
Spring Boot adds to its JSON mapper, so `bankmasker.fields` rules apply. Works with
Jackson 2, Jackson 3 or both. Warns when HTTP responses use Gson/JSON-B.
Backs off when the application declares its own `MaskingConfig` bean, logs a WARN when
`bankmasker.enabled=false`, and fails at startup on an invalid mask character
(control characters or UTF-16 surrogates).

---

## Common Patterns

### DTO with all mask types:
```java
public class SensitiveDTO {
    @MaskData(MaskType.CREDIT_CARD)  private String card;
    @MaskData(MaskType.EMAIL)        private String email;
    @MaskData(MaskType.PHONE)        private String phone;
    @MaskData(MaskType.IBAN)         private String iban;
    @MaskData(MaskType.SSN)          private String ssn;
    @MaskData(MaskType.NAME)         private String name;
    @MaskData(MaskType.DNI)          private String dni;
    @MaskData(MaskType.PASSPORT)     private String passport;
    @MaskData(MaskType.BANK_ACCOUNT) private String account;
    @MaskData(MaskType.IP_ADDRESS)   private String ip;
    @MaskData(MaskType.AUTO)         private String detected;   // card/email/IBAN auto-detect
    @MaskData                        private String secret;     // TOTAL
    @MaskData(value = MaskType.CUSTOM, maskChar = '#', visibleStart = 2, visibleEnd = 3)
    private String custom;
}
```

### Java record:
```java
public record PaymentRecord(
    @MaskData(MaskType.CREDIT_CARD) String card,
    @MaskData(MaskType.EMAIL) String email,
    String plainField
) {}
```

### In toString() / logs:
```java
@Override
public String toString() {
    return "User{card=" + MaskUtils.mask(card, MaskType.CREDIT_CARD) + "}";
}
log.info("Payment for {}", MaskUtils.mask(card, MaskType.CREDIT_CARD));
```

### Disable masking globally:
```java
MaskingConfig.getInstance().setEnabled(false);
```

### Custom audit:
```java
MaskingConfig.getInstance().setAuditLogger((field, type) ->
    auditService.record(field, type, Instant.now()));
```

### Imports needed:
```java
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskData;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskType;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskUtils;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskingConfig;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskingModule;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskingStrategy;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.MaskingAuditLogger;
import io.github.zeytx.bankmasker.Slf4jMaskingAuditLogger;
```
